meta.name: Ensure AWS Bedrock agent is associated with Bedrock guardrails
meta.description: Ensure AWS Bedrock agent is associated with Bedrock guardrails
meta.remediation: Add a guardrail_configuration block with guardrail_identifier to every aws_bedrockagent_agent.

evaluators.description: Every aws_bedrockagent_agent must carry guardrail_configuration.0.guardrail_identifier. The block is a list in the plan, so an absent one is [] in change.after -- a severity-2 miss, which fails at error_tolerance 1.
